scorecard.name: Hold time and Dead Air
scorecard.coaching: Agent left the customer in unannounced silence (>30s) more than once.

scorecard.name: Empathy & Acknowledgment Statement
scorecard.coaching: Failed to show empathy to customer's frustration.

scorecard.name: Took ownership of the problem
scorecard.coaching: Agent deflected responsibility or blamed another team instead of owning the issue.

scorecard.name: Build rapport and observed professionalism
scorecard.coaching: Agent used rude or condescending language.

scorecard.name: Confirmed the issue is resolved
scorecard.coaching: Before closing, ask the customer to confirm the issue is fixed and state clearly that it is resolved.

grader.graded_by: Claude (written and graded before any model run; not human-reviewed)
grader.notes: H: two unannounced silences (~50 s, ~45 s). E: customer upset about a missed refund promise; ignored. R: "I can't help you if you keep interrupting me." O: "Whoever told you that was wrong, I can't do anything about what other agents promise." CR: no resolution confirmed.
